result.brief: 提出 NegWAM，用近专家负轨迹作为排斥锚点与场景条件 token，对统一世界-动作模型做安全后训练，提升自动驾驶安全关键场景表现。
result.reason: Proposes safety post-training for a unified world-action model with flow-matching objectives and scene-conditioned tokens; main contribution is driving policy training, so it fits the applications direction.
